text: Discuss the ways in which the extract constructs meaning through the following:
• camera shots, angles, movement and composition
• editing
• sound
• mise-en-scène. [50]
Section B: Institutions and audiences
Answer one question from this section.
Refer to specific examples from one media area chosen from:
• film
• music
• print
• radio
• video games.
How significant has the spread of technology in recent years been for audiences? Refer to the
media area you have studied. [50]
OR
‘The production of all media texts is driven by profit.’ To what extent do you agree with this? [50]
